_comment: Provenance of every export kept under registers/source/. Each is a RENDERING of the live Google Sheet, not the native object's bytes: Drive reports the native Sheet's size (fileSize 1,357,600 at the 2026-09-18 export; 1,345,511 at the 2026-09-17 export) and no digest, so no export can be byte-exact against the source and every record here carries exact: false. Fidelity is enforced downstream instead: tools/registers_import.py --check fails CI if registers/json or registers/csv drift from the current import source. Exports are never edited in place; a refresh is a NEW dated export plus regenerated outputs (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

exports.modified_time_note: The 2026-09-17 export did not record the Sheet's modifiedTime; Drive's fileSize for the native object at that export was 1,345,511 (governance/PROVENANCE.json).
exports.export_method: Google Drive connector read_file_content: markdown-table rendering of every sheet, one table per sheet, sheets in workbook order
exports.export_mime: text/markdown (a rendering; the native object is application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet)
exports.status: SUPERSEDED as the import source on 2026-09-18; retained byte for byte and never edited
exports.defect: TRUNCATED_RENDERING: the connector's markdown rendering returned only a prefix of seven large tabs. The prefix rows it did return agree cell for cell with the xlsx export apart from markdown escaping (\<, \`, \~, <), the '[merged] ' repetition of merged cells, date serials rounded to five decimals, one mangled emoji and in-cell newlines flattened to spaces. Every derived file in this repository built before 2026-09-18 saw only these prefixes.
exports.truncation_evidence: Row counts compared against the 2026-09-18 xlsx export by tools/registers_import.py; the markdown rendering of the same live workbook taken minutes before the xlsx export (2026-09-18) showed the identical cut, so the cut is a property of the rendering, not of an edit to the Sheet.

exports.export_method: Google Drive connector download_file_content, exporting the native Sheet as application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet; bytes written from the base64 content of the result, unchanged
exports.export_mime: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet (a rendering; the native object is application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet)
exports.exact_note: An xlsx export of a native Google Sheet is a rendering; Drive's fileSize 1,357,600 is the native object, not this export, so the byte counts are not comparable and there is no source digest to compare against.
exports.completeness: All 44 worksheets are complete: the seven tabs the markdown rendering truncated are delivered in full (file_catalog 2952, activity_log 518, artifact_index 761, transition_log 82, review_ledger 138, evidence_lineage 485, relations 367 rows). Two worksheets were added to the workbook after the 2026-09-17 export: Reusable Operations (15 rows) and Operation Trials (header only).

exports.export_method: Authenticated Drive raw XLSX export, uploaded as immutable R1, downloaded and compared byte for byte. A hash-pinned lossless delta transported those exact export bytes into GitHub; successful Python 3.11 run 35918474959 created the expected Git blob. No native Sheet cell was edited by this transfer.
exports.export_mime: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet (a rendering; the native object is application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet)
exports.exact_note: Not byte-exact against the native Sheet. Byte-exact against the independently downloaded immutable R1 export, including all ZIP headers and members.
exports.status: VERIFIED SUCCESSOR STORED / NOT YET SELECTED AS CANONICAL IMPORT SOURCE
exports.completeness: Unchanged importer generated 44 JSON and 44 CSV files twice, byte-identically, in Python 3.11.16. Review Queue has 40 data rows and exactly one occurrence of each H3-solver, withdrawal and rollout-R2 review key. Later Work Events are outside this snapshot.
exports.next_step: Select this successor and regenerate canonical JSON/CSV in a separate coherent change; retain the historical Sept17-to-Sept18 diff on its original sources. Do not hand-edit generated registers.
exports.truncation_evidence: None in this export. An earlier automatic mount of the same Drive object was truncated at 1,048,576 bytes and failed ZIP integrity; that copy was rejected and is not this file. Recorded because a rejected artifact leaves no other trace.
exports.measured_refusals: python3 tools/register_migration_preflight.py --source registers/source/GP-REG-032_v1.2_export_2026-09-23_R1.xlsx reports four checkers refusing this export as it stands: registers_check and reviews_check on three review_queue rows whose Technical status is prose outside the R17 section 4 set; lanes_check on 15 review routes absent from engine/lanes/D.json; frozen_check on 11 frozen_objects rows (9 Drive IDs absent from drive/inventory.jsonl, 2 carrying a description where Binding Class expects a class). quarantine_check accepts it. Adoption changes 8 tabs and so 16 generated files. These are the checks working; the review_queue and Binding Class cells are source defects and repair belongs at source under CLAUDE.md rule 7, not here.
exports.inventory_note: The 9 frozen_check misses are not repairable in git. drive/inventory.jsonl derives from drive/source_map/Files.csv, which on 2026-09-23 was byte-identical to the live Drive object 1gJwebwkKnRcb3Ez8atJ0WTk9f7HmP1y3 (2,503,504 bytes, sha256 4bad6b97c96a86382e200d31e50ac06932fdbbc8ad26a568559664441769c48e). The accessibility publication has not been re-run since 2026-09-17 and those objects were frozen after it, so no faithful inventory can contain them until that run is repeated.

exports.export_method: Delivered by the ChatGPT session that repaired the source cells, as immutable Drive object 1mVGU5BZD0lR4OwzAjlhbeSbrajRUAtow. This session downloaded that object independently and confirmed the byte count and SHA-256 below, zipfile.testzip() clean, 153 ZIP members and 44 worksheet parts.
exports.export_mime: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet (a rendering; the native object is application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet)
exports.exact_note: Not byte-exact against the native Sheet. Byte-exact against the independently downloaded immutable R2 export.
exports.difference_from_r1: Independently diffed cell by cell through tools/registers_import.py, not taken on report. Exactly six cell values differ, all in review_queue rows 34-36: Technical status on each goes from prose to the R17 section 4 word READY, and each original phrase is appended verbatim to that row's Next action with a note that READY means awaiting the required review, not a PASS. No header changed and no row was removed. work_events grows 166 to 174 rows by append, the first 166 unchanged; the delivering session's summary said 'no added/deleted rows', which holds for every tab but that append-only log.
exports.status: RECEIVED AND VERIFIED, NOT YET THE IMPORT SOURCE. Retained byte for byte so the transfer never has to be repeated.
exports.measured_refusals: python3 tools/register_migration_preflight.py --source registers/source/GP-REG-032_v1.2_export_2026-09-23_R2.xlsx reports two checkers still refusing, down from four for R1. registers_check now reports new=0 and reviews_check 0 problems: the source repair cleared exactly what it was meant to clear. lanes_check refuses 15 review routes absent from engine/lanes/D.json, which is this repository's work and is coupled to adoption because that check is symmetric -- a route added to the lane before the register carries it is refused just as loudly. frozen_check refuses 11 rows: 9 Drive IDs absent from drive/inventory.jsonl and 2 carrying a description where Binding Class expects a class. Activation is blocked on those 11 and on nothing else.
exports.does_not_establish: Downloading an export and diffing it against its predecessor establishes what changed between two files. It does not establish that either is a faithful rendering of the native Sheet, does not verify a register cell's meaning, and moves no status. READY is the register's own word, transcribed here and nowhere decided.

does_not_establish: An export records what the Sheet held at one moment. It certifies nothing, promotes nothing and closes nothing: every status word in registers/json is the register's own word, transcribed, and a register row is not a verdict.
